en: Vintage illustrated postcard showing two young girls in light-colored, old-fashioned dresses sitting on the grass outdoors. One girl sits on a rock holding a basket of white daisies and handing flowers to the other girl. The scene has soft pastel colors and a romantic, late‑19th/early‑20th‑century style. On the right side there is handwritten text in a Scandinavian language, and small printed text appears vertically at the lower left edge.
